resources.string: 100% on-device · No cloud · No accounts · No ads
Start live captions when you are ready

whisper.cpp Tiny (language=auto) · all 18 Languages · any app · ML Kit MT to your target after ASR. EN→EN stays ASR-only (no MT wait). SenseVoice is optional advanced only — not the any-language Live path.

Continuous multilingual captions over any app via whisper.cpp Tiny (auto). Covers the full Languages list; ML Kit translates to your target after ASR. EN→EN is the fast ASR-only path. Optional SenseVoice is a limited zh/en/ja/ko/yue lane — not required for Live.
Pick languages and caption font below. Scroll to Start for live captions.
Save subtitles to a text file
When on, each live session writes a .txt file under the app Documents/captions folder on this device. Local only.
Captions float above videos and games. Android needs “display over other apps” so the bubble can stay visible while you watch something else.
Caption Action captions sounds playing on your device (videos, games, media) — never your microphone. Android still requires this permission for screen-audio capture. Audio never leaves your phone.
A quiet notification keeps the live session running in the background.

When you tap Start, Android asks which screen to share so Caption Action can hear app playback (YouTube, games, media). Captions use device audio only — never the microphone. Choose entire screen (or the app playing audio) and Allow.
Permissions ready — tap Start live captions again to begin.
Allow screen sharing to caption device audio
Caption Action requires Android 10+ for device audio
SenseVoice (optional) · zh/en/ja/ko/yue only (~228 MB) · not all-language Live
Balanced — ggml Tiny Q5 (~31 MB) · Live continuous (default)
Live defaults to Balanced (whisper Tiny, all Languages). SenseVoice is optional and limited. Models stay on your phone; interrupted downloads can resume.
Download the model to start live captions.
Dual subtitles need a supported target language from the list (offline ML Kit MT).
Permission still needed — try again from the explanation screen.
Not enough storage for the model.
Model missing or incomplete. Download Balanced (Live default) or optional SenseVoice to start captions.
Could not capture device playback audio. Try Start again.
Screen-share grant could not be used (expired or already consumed). Tap Start and Allow again.
Screen/audio capture was stopped. Captions ended.
Could not load on-device ASR. Re-download the selected model or reinstall the app.
Device-audio captions active — tap the green dot to end
Partial download found — tap to resume

Offline MT does not support target %1$s.
Offline translation: Google ML Kit on-device (any tier → Languages list). Packs prepare in the background — Start does not wait on them. Whisper EN translate remains a fast path.
Translation pack issue: %1$s — packs keep preparing in the background. Captions may stay in the spoken language until ready.
Translation pack missing for this language pair. Connect once to download, then retry.
